events_seen: CUT (Nov 10 (today)): Fronge released Emari Demercado (RB, HOU).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 07 (3 days ago)): Shaq added Audric Estime (RB, NO) for $6 FAAB (dropped AJ Dillon (RB, CAR)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 07 (3 days ago)): Mitchum added Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF) (dropped John Metchie III (WR, CAR)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 07 (3 days ago)): Adam added Gregory Desrosiers (RB, NYG) (dropped Kendre Miller (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 05 (5 days ago)): Adam added Stetson Bennett IV (QB, LAR) (dropped Audric Estime (RB, NO)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 05 (5 days ago)): Fronge added Emari Demercado (RB, HOU) for $1 FAAB.
CUT (Nov 05 (5 days ago)): Jake released Najee Harris (RB, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 04 (6 days ago)): Adam added Carson Wentz (QB, MIN) for $7 FAAB (dropped George Holani (RB, SEA)).

WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION: Fronge releases Emari Demercado (RB, HOU) today — the same player they spent $1 FAAB on five days ago. ForgeHammer's RB desk is a revolving door and there is not a single 2027 pick backing it up.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week nine is fully graded. Drew is 0-18. The Ledger is not going to dress that up — there is no precedent for a winless record at this stage of a dynasty season, and the Atlas rebuild has no visible bottom. The board agrees: $30.71 as of November fourth.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin over Drew and Mitchum over Shaq and both came through clean, so my week nine card read 2-0 on those. I would also like the record to show that my season is 7-5 and I have no complaints about where I sit relative to Terrence, who is at 5-7 and still filing takes as though the standings are negotiable.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Wingard-Adam pick cost me and I accept that. What I will not accept is Dexter treating a 7-5 record like it is a mandate when four of those wins came in weeks where every pundit on this network picked the same side. Season's not over.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Corbishley at $136.58 walks into this week facing Wingard at $53.08. Wingard just beat Adam by 35 points and nobody saw it coming. I am previewing Apex as the favorite but I am doing it with both eyes open after what this league produced in week nine.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin versus Ryan in week ten is the game I want a full segment on. Kevin is 13-5, sitting third. Ryan is 9-9, defending champion, ranked ninth by Matteo, just beat the second-place franchise by 25 points. That matchup does not resolve cleanly and I need someone at this network to treat it like it doesn't.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Ryan beat Corbishley 115.7-90.9 and my mentions have been unreadable since Tuesday night. The ranking is about receiver grade, pick depth, and roster trajectory over a trailing window — not one result against a team that also had a bad week. Nine is nine until the structure changes.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Shaq versus Brent in week ten is the matchup that actually shapes the bubble. Shaq is 9-9, Brent is 10-8, and OBS put up 165 points last week. Monarch added Estime, still have the WR wealth, still have the RB hole. This one is live and I am not confident in either direction.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: ForgeHammer beat the number-one seed in a nail-biter, then cut the RB they claimed on waivers five days ago, and their headquarters is in Havana. The Ledger is going to need a geography section at this rate.
